description.text: Environmental science and engineering is an interdisciplinary subject that integrates environmental science, engineering technology, management, and ecology, aiming to study the formation mechanism, evolution laws, and solutions of environmental problems. This major takes "sustainable development" as its core, focusing on areas such as environmental pollution control, ecological protection, and resource recycling. Through the combination of theoretical research and engineering practice, it aims to cultivate compound talents with capabilities in environmental monitoring, pollution control, environmental planning, and management.

duration.text: The Environmental Science and Engineering at Jinan University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Copy of passport or other valid IDs With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 2. Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.3. Graduation certificate of high schoolGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.4. Academic transcript of high school5.Letter of recommendation From Chinese Embassies, consulates, charge de affairs, overseas Chinese communities, overseas Chinese schools or famous people from overseas Chinese communities or headmaster of high school.

requirements.text: Applicants for a doctoral degree in China must hold a degree equivalent to a master's degree from a Chinese university, be no older than 40 years old, and score 195 on HSK Level 4
